title: Number Bonds to 10
seo_title: Number Bonds to 10 – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Break numbers up to 10 into two parts in different ways; find the missing part; make 10. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: number bonds and ways to make 5 and 10, part-part-whole and missing parts. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: 5 is 2 and 3, or 4 and 1, or 5 and 0.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • The whole is the big number. The parts are the two small numbers.
  • Part + part = whole.
  • If you know the whole and one part, count on to find the other part.

Examples

Example

7 is 3 and what?

Count on from 3: 4, 5, 6, 7

That is 4 more

Answer: 4

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Adding the whole and the partThe missing part is smaller than the whole.
Forgetting 010 and 0 also make 10.
Counting the first part againStart after it: 3, then 4, 5, 6, 7.

faq.q: How many ways can I make 5?
faq.a: 0 and 5, 1 and 4, 2 and 3 (and the other way round).
They help you add and take away fast.
